schema:alternativeHeadline: Scan page 24 of Magpie, no. 1, vol. 26. Cartoon of a disheveled person in a patched brimmed hat, rumpled jacket, striped trousers and ragged shoes, sitting with legs spread against a horizontal rail and holding a small bottle at the lap. Musical notes float around the head. Caption: “Come alive...you’re in the Pepsi generation!”
